newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SVCD Bucharest bourse prices, turnover slip.
newsitem.headline: SVCD Bucharest bourse prices, turnover slip.

text.p: Thin investor interest pulled most share prices as well as turnover lower at the Bucharest bourse's first weekly session on Tuesday.
"The market was again dominated by small investors so volumes stayed light," one trader said.
Eight of the 13 traded stocks fell, three rose, one marked time and one had no trade.
Turnover fell to 56.1 million lei from 92 million as demand for star performer Azomures SA fertiliser maker was slimmer, another trader said.

Azomures, which thanks to its liquidity and healthy results has dominated trading this year, was still in the limelight on Tuesday, taking 61 percent of total turnover. But larger supply drove its closing price down to 10,900 lei from 12,100.
Investors on Tuesday also focused on engineer Artrom SA, which had 11.8 million lei in turnover and traded more than half the total 9,451 shares which changed hands.
Artrom closed 250 lei weaker at 2,300 under selling pressure. Brokers said they expected selling pressure to continue at the week's second session on Thursday.

Two independent value-weighted indexes on Tuesday showed drops from the previous session. Both unofficial indexes -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities company, and the BIG, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group SA brokerage house -- were 5.4 percent down on last Thursday's session. Their base was 1,000 points when they were created last November.
